inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close patch of bare flat warm tan stone ground on a high windswept plateau, wind scoured and cracked, with nothing lying on it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bare natural stone ground, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Clear cold morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#bfe0f4", "#ffffff", "#6a88b0", "#d4c4a4", "#b0a084", "#7c7480", "#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#4a2350", "#a050e0", "#f2a24a", "#2e2c38", "#e0a070"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A patch of the flat bare plateau floor seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "flat bare warm tan stone of the plateau, wind scoured and cracked"}]}}
